results.label: this tree ships the M110 news-window module (the committed parent does not, and that absence is this probe's control)
a new account stores the episode defaults: 15 minutes before, 45 minutes after
the creation response carries the pair and the honest note about it
the two fields are separate columns on the account row, not one knob
both settings are storable at their bounds (block 60, settle 30)
a 5-minute block is accepted (he demonstrates it) and the settle stays at its own default
the creation response warns about the block, quoting his recommendation, without refusing it
a settle below the 30-minute floor is refused 400 with its own code and nothing created
the old single knob is refused on creation rather than split for the caller
a hostile settle (booleans) is refused as invalid, not coerced
a hostile settle (arrays) is refused as invalid, not coerced
a hostile settle (objects) is refused as invalid, not coerced
a hostile settle (blanks) is refused as invalid, not coerced
a hostile settle (fractions) is refused as invalid, not coerced
a hostile settle (zero) is refused as invalid, not coerced
a hostile settle (above the maximum) is refused as invalid, not coerced
a hostile settle (huge) is refused as invalid, not coerced
an update that tries to shorten the settle to 5 is refused 400 and the stored row is untouched
an update that shortens only the block succeeds and warns
that update did NOT touch the settle: the two settings move independently
an unrelated edit (a rename) leaves both news settings exactly as stored
the old single knob is refused on update too, with nothing written

results.label: with no query pair the endpoint uses that account’s stored pair (block 5 on this desk, settle 45)
omitting account_id resolves the trader’s OWN default desk (15/45), never another account’s pair
and reports the release 40 minutes ago as blocked on the after side while the 40-minute-ahead one is clear
the settings note travels with the answer, names the same numbers, its sources and the models limit
per-request research overrides are honoured, echoed, and their sources say they came from the request
the wider research pair now blocks the release due in 40 minutes, on the before side
the settle floor applies to research overrides too: ?after=5 is refused
hostile query values are refused rather than coerced
another trader sees only their own desk, and it carries the episode defaults rather than this one’s pair
and their news endpoint reports the defaults 15/45, not the first desk’s 5/45
another trader cannot edit this account’s news settings at all

scope: M110 API: the two news settings, the settle floor, the refused single knob, per-account pair: actual runtime/auth/SQL/HTTP with a frozen UTC clock and a synthetic calendar fed through the app's own parser; two asymmetric news clocks, no provider/broker/pixel/human proof and no claim about what a release does to price
